product_flow.name: Software cartridges for video game consoles

required_qualifiers: game title and release hash
rights and accepted ROM provenance
target console and regional interface
actual flash memory technology and capacity
mapper and CIC or other actual support-chip configuration
supplied module versus onsite board-assembly route
BOM and shell construction
measured configuration-specific cartridge net mass and count
first release criteria and unique release identifiers
failed and rejected physical disposition
period H and every site
opening and closing stock and inherited burdens
programming and test coverage
software-original and licence accounting boundary
packaging configuration and exclusion from Q
actual utility state and supplier boundaries
upstream dataset coverage and allocation evidence
游戏名称及发布哈希
权利及已接受 ROM 来源
目标主机与地区接口
实际闪存技术和容量
映射器及 CIC 或其他实际支持芯片配置
外购模块或厂内电路板装联路线
物料清单及壳体结构
按配置实测的卡带净质量和件数
首次放行准则及唯一放行标识
失败与拒收实物流向
期间 H 及全部场址
期初期末库存及继承负荷
烧录及测试覆盖范围
软件原始资产及许可的核算边界
包装配置及不计入 Q 的规定
实际公用工程状态及供方边界
上游数据集覆盖及分配证据
